records.applicationMethod: High potassium demand is critical for root starch accumulation. Apply in a ring or band (15-20 cm from plant) at 6 to 8 weeks after planting once root systems establish. Second split of remaining K2O applied at 16 weeks. Commercial grade equivalent: approx. 6-8 bags of NPK 15-15-15 + 2 bags MOP (Muriate of Potash) per hectare.
records.applicationTiming: Ring/band at 6-8 weeks after planting; second K2O split at 16 weeks.
records.notes: IITA AKILIMO Decision Support System; NRCRI Umudike Advisory.
records.source_org: IITA (International Institute of Tropical Agriculture), Ibadan
records.source_org_2: NRCRI (National Root Crops Research Institute), Umudike
records.source_title: AKILIMO Decision Support System — Cassava fertilizer recommendation

records.applicationMethod: Banded or pocket placement on mounds/ridges at 8 to 10 weeks after emergence (after vine development and shoot establishment, avoiding direct contact with tuber head). Commercial grade equivalent: approx. 6-7 bags NPK 15-15-15 + 1.5 bags Urea per hectare.
records.applicationTiming: Banded/pocket placement at 8-10 weeks after emergence.
records.notes: NRCRI Umudike; IITA YIIFSWA (Yam Improvement for Income and Food Security in West Africa).
records.source_org: NRCRI (National Root Crops Research Institute), Umudike

records.applicationMethod: Avoid excess nitrogen to prevent vigorous foliage growth without tuber expansion. Full P2O5 and 50% K2O at vine planting; balance N and K2O side-dressed at 4 weeks after vine planting during ridge earthing-up.
records.applicationTiming: Full P + 50% K at planting; balance N+K side-dressed at 4 weeks.
records.source_org: NRCRI (National Root Crops Research Institute), Umudike

records.applicationMethod: Basal dose (all P2O5, K2O, and 1/3 N) applied banded 5 cm beside and below seeds at planting or 10-14 days after emergence (DAE). Remaining nitrogen top-dressed at 4 to 6 weeks after planting (knee-high stage / V6). Commercial grade equivalent: 4 bags NPK 15-15-15 or NPK 20-10-10 basal + 2.5-3 bags Urea top-dressed per hectare.
records.applicationTiming: Basal at planting/10-14 DAE; N top-dress at 4-6 weeks (V6).
records.notes: IAR Samaru, Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria; IITA Maize Agronomy Unit.
records.source_org: IAR Samaru (Institute for Agricultural Research), Zaria
records.source_title: Maize fertilizer recommendation — Nigeria (Southern Guinea Savanna)

records.applicationMethod: Basal dose (all P2O5, K2O, and 1/3 N) applied banded 5 cm beside and below seeds at planting or 10-14 days after emergence (DAE). Remaining nitrogen top-dressed at 4 to 6 weeks after planting (knee-high stage / V6).
records.applicationTiming: Basal at planting/10-14 DAE; N top-dress at 4-6 weeks (V6).
records.notes: IAR Samaru; IITA Maize Agronomy Unit.
records.source_org: IAR Samaru (Institute for Agricultural Research), Zaria

records.applicationMethod: Basal compound fertilizer incorporated during last harrowing/puddling. Urea top-dressed in 2 equal splits: active tillering (21 DAT) and panicle initiation (45 DAT). Commercial grade equivalent: 4-5 bags NPK 15-15-15 + 2 bags Urea per hectare.
records.applicationTiming: Basal at puddling; Urea splits at 21 DAT and 45 DAT.

records.applicationMethod: Basal compound fertilizer incorporated during last harrowing/puddling. Urea top-dressed in 2 equal splits: active tillering (21 DAT) and panicle initiation (45 DAT).
records.applicationTiming: Basal at puddling; Urea splits at 21 DAT and 45 DAT.

records.applicationMethod: Basal application of full P and K along with 1/2 N at 2 to 3 weeks after sowing; remaining 1/2 N side-dressed at 6 to 7 weeks after sowing.
records.applicationTiming: 1/2 N + full P/K at 2-3 weeks; remaining N at 6-7 weeks.
records.notes: IAR Samaru, Zaria; ICRISAT West Africa Sorghum Program.
records.source_org: IAR Samaru (Institute for Agricultural Research), Zaria

records.applicationMethod: Banded basal application at 2 weeks after thinning; remaining N top-dressed after first weeding around 5 weeks.
records.applicationTiming: Basal at 2 weeks after thinning; N top-dress ~5 weeks.
records.notes: IAR Samaru; Lake Chad Research Institute (LCRI), Maiduguri.
records.source_org: IAR Samaru (Institute for Agricultural Research), Zaria

records.applicationMethod: 100% applied at sowing banded along planting lines (5 cm from seed). Excess nitrogen suppresses biological nitrogen fixation. Phosphorus is critical for nodulation and pod fill. Commercial grade equivalent: approx. 2 bags Single Superphosphate (SSP) or 1 bag DAP + 0.5 bag MOP per hectare.
records.notes: IITA Grain Legume Directorate; IAR Samaru Legume Program.

records.applicationMethod: Complete dose applied basally into seed furrow with rhizobial inoculant (Nodumax or Bradyrhizobium japonicum).
records.applicationTiming: 100% basal into seed furrow with inoculant.
records.notes: IITA Soybean Production Manual for West Africa.
records.source_org: IITA Soybean Production Manual for West Africa

records.applicationMethod: NPK applied basally at sowing; Gypsum (200-300 kg/ha) broadcast over rows at 35-40 DAE (flowering/pegging) for shell calcification.
records.applicationTiming: NPK basal at sowing; Gypsum at 35-40 DAE.
records.notes: IAR Samaru Oilseeds Program; ICRISAT Nigeria.

records.applicationMethod: Full P2O5 and 30% of N and K placed in transplant beds. Remaining N and K split in two side-dressings: 3 weeks after transplanting and early fruiting.
records.applicationTiming: Basal in transplant beds; side-dress at 3 weeks and early fruiting.
records.notes: NIHORT Ibadan; IAR Samaru Horticultural Section.

records.applicationMethod: Basal bed application (NPK 15-15-15) followed by monthly top-dressing of N and K during continuous harvest flushes.
records.applicationTiming: Basal bed application; monthly N+K top-dress during harvest.

records.applicationMethod: Basal P and K before transplanting sets; N applied in 2 splits (3 weeks and 6 weeks after transplanting; halt N 30 days before harvest to allow neck closure).
records.applicationTiming: P+K basal; N splits at 3 and 6 weeks after transplanting.
records.notes: IAR Samaru (Kano & Sokoto irrigated field recommendations).
records.source_org: IAR Samaru (Institute for Agricultural Research), Zaria

records.applicationMethod: Broadcast and incorporated into ridges at sowing; light nitrogen top-dressings after cutting flushes for leafy greens. Also applies to indigenous leafy vegetables (Ugu/Fluted pumpkin, Ewedu/Jute mallow, Amaranth).
records.applicationTiming: Broadcast at sowing; light N top-dress after cutting flushes.
records.notes: NIHORT Ibadan Vegetable Guidelines. Covers okra + indigenous leafy vegetables (Ugu, Ewedu, Amaranth).
records.source_title: Okra & leafy vegetables fertilizer recommendation — Nigeria

records.applicationMethod: Source-faithful per-palm dose: N 800-1200 g, P2O5 400-600 g, K2O 1200-1800 g, Kieserite (Mg) 500 g, Borate 50-100 g per palm per year (~143 palms/ha). Applied in circular ring (1.5-2 m radius from stem) split into 2 applications: onset of rains (April/May) and end of heavy rains (September/October). Per-hectare numeric equivalent at standard density: N 114.4-171.6, P2O5 57.2-85.8, K2O 171.6-257.4 kg/ha.
records.applicationTiming: 2 splits: onset of rains (Apr/May) and end of heavy rains (Sep/Oct).
records.notes: NIFOR (Nigerian Institute for Oil Palm Research), Benin City. ~143 palms/ha mature field.
records.source_org: NIFOR (Nigerian Institute for Oil Palm Research), Benin City

records.applicationMethod: Applied in 2 split doses: first at early flushing/flowering (April/May) and second during mid pod filling (August/September). Specialized cocoa fertilizer formulation: CRIN-formulated Cocoa Fertilizer NPK 0-20-20 or 5-10-15.
records.applicationTiming: 2 splits: early flushing (Apr/May) and mid pod filling (Aug/Sep).
records.notes: CRIN (Cocoa Research Institute of Nigeria), Ibadan.
records.source_org: CRIN (Cocoa Research Institute of Nigeria), Ibadan

records.applicationMethod: Basal furrow placement at planting setts (full P and K + 1/3 N); remaining N top-dressed in 2 equal doses at 2 months and 4 months before canopy closure.
records.applicationTiming: Basal furrow at planting; N top-dress at 2 and 4 months.
